description: The permission slip and $85 are still flat in the bottom of Ezra's backpack, unsigned and unpaid.
Mr. Whitcomb sends a reminder via the school app to families who haven't submitted the form or fee. The message is sent to Chris and Naomi's accounts.

Naomi opens her email and sees the school app digest from this morning. The digest includes a summary of the class newsletter sent Monday, which mentions the nature camp trip and the September 18 deadline.
The reminder message arrives in Chris's school app inbox.
Naomi opens the school app; the app displays its main feed with no new messages about Ezra's class visible without further navigation.
Mr. Whitcomb opens the school app and checks the list of returned permission slips and payments. He sees that Ezra's form is still missing.
Mr. Whitcomb sends a direct message to Chris and Naomi via the school app, reminding them that the permission slip and fee are due by 3 p.m. Friday.
The reminder message remains in Chris's school app inbox, unopened.
Chris arrives home and goes to Ezra's room to check the backpack. He finds the backpack and retrieves the folder containing the permission slip.
Chris pulls the permission slip out of the folder and glances at it.

Chris puts the permission slip on the kitchen counter and goes to the living room to check his phone. He sees a notification badge on the school app icon but does not open it, assuming it's a general reminder he'll look at tomorrow.
The school app email digest is sent to Naomi's email, containing summaries of the general reminder and the direct message from Mr. Whitcomb about the permission slip and fee.
The email digest arrives in Naomi's inbox.
Chris walks into the kitchen, sees the permission slip on the counter, and picks it up to look at it.
Naomi's phone receives the email digest notification, but she is driving home from work and does not look at her phone.
Chris reads the permission slip thoroughly, noting the details and the deadline of 3 p.m. Friday.
Chris picks up a pen from the counter and starts filling out the permission slip, writing Ezra's name and signing his own signature.
Chris looks at the clock and realizes the school office won't be open for another two hours, so he cannot drop it off immediately. He considers asking Naomi but she is not home yet.
Chris sets the permission slip down on the counter and walks to the drawer where he keeps his wallet and checkbook. He opens the drawer and looks inside.
Chris sees the checkbook and wallet in the drawer.
Chris finishes writing Ezra's name and signing his own signature on the permission slip.
Chris pulls out the checkbook and opens it to write a check for $85.
Chris picks up his phone, sees the notification badge on the school app, and opens the app.
Chris sees the unread messages from Mr. Whitcomb in the school app inbox.
Chris taps on the first unread message from Mr. Whitcomb to open and read it.
Chris taps the phone icon to open the dialer and selects Naomi's contact to call her.
Chris's phone dials Naomi's number and begins to ring.
The call rings several times then goes to voicemail. Chris hears the voicemail greeting.
The voicemail greeting plays, then the beep sounds, indicating Chris can leave a message.
Chris speaks into the phone, leaving a voicemail for Naomi explaining that the permission slip and check are on the kitchen counter and asking if she can drop them off at the school office by 3pm.
The voicemail is recorded and saved in Naomi's voicemail inbox. Her phone receives a notification that she has a new voicemail, but she does not see or hear it while driving.
Mr. Whitcomb opens the school app and starts composing a new message to Chris and Naomi reminding them the permission slip and fee are due by 3 p.m. Friday.
Mr. Whitcomb finishes typing the message and taps send. The message is sent to Chris and Naomi's school app inboxes.
Naomi parks the car, turns off the engine, and picks up her phone. She sees the email digest notification and the voicemail notification, but does not open either yet.
Naomi puts her phone in her bag without opening any notifications, gets out of the car, and walks toward her front door.

Naomi walks into the house, sets down her bag, and pulls out her phone. She sees the voicemail notification and the email digest notification. She taps the voicemail notification to listen to Chris's message.
Naomi listens to Chris's voicemail explaining that the permission slip and check are on the kitchen counter and asking if she can drop them off at the school office by 3pm.
The voicemail ends. Naomi's phone screen shows the voicemail has been marked as listened. She is holding her phone in the living room.
Naomi looks at the time display on her phone and sees it is 4:44 p.m., confirming the deadline has passed.
Naomi walks from the living room to the kitchen.
Naomi opens the school app on her phone.
The school app opens to its main screen, displaying a list of recent messages. An unread message from Mr. Whitcomb is visible in the inbox.
